_about: Shops (Shop, ShopMenu, ShopScreen; README.md, Shops). Per shop: name, map (its inside, data/maps), open [first hour, closing hour) and days_off (mon..sun): outside those the door and the counter only say closed_message (%s = the shop name, then the hours and the days off). keeper: the villager who stands at the counter ("" = nobody; the counter works without one); with a keeper the shop also sells only while their day plan has them on the shop's map, and talking to them at the map's keeper spot opens it. stock: what it sells, per season plus "any" (every season), each {item, price?}: without a price the item's own one is used (seed_price in crops.json for seeds:<crop>, price in foods.json for food:<id>). buys: what it buys from the farmer, kind -> percent of the item's value (crop = its sell price, food = its price). upgrades: tools it improves, per target level {price, days, items?}; the tool is handed in, comes back that many days later (collect it while the shop is open). Names, prices and hours are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Shops.
